mechanism: Nicotine induces CYP2C9 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing phenytoin metabolism and reducing its anticonvulsant efficacy; nicotine also increases cardiac workload which may complicate seizure threshold management.
action: Monitor serum phenytoin levels closely in patients using nicotine products; adjust phenytoin dosing if needed and counsel patients on smoking cessation to maintain stable anticonvulsant concentrations.
